summary: Phase 4 strategy frozen. Seven product/technical decisions recorded in phase-4-decisions.md: (4.1) new gameCompletions FLAT table with schoolId notNull + unique constraint (schoolId, userId, activityId), plus xpLogs unique constraint (userId, activityId) for race-safe fire-once, plus dual-write in recordGameCompletion so getStudentProgress#xpTotal read path is unchanged; (4.2) tenant registry reclassification — gameCompletions FLAT (new), leaderboards.schoolId migrated to notNull (B46-027 closure), xpLogs remains REFERENTIAL (dual-write keeps it as XP ledger), gameRankings remains REFERENTIAL and deprecated (no new writes); (4.3) getSchoolLeaderboard domain query over gameCompletions through TenantDB without unscoped() (auto-scoped by schoolId), shared LeaderboardResponseSchema, standalone rankingRoute validates via schema + canonical medium difficulty key; (4.4) recordActivityInputSchema + updateLessonProgressInputSchema with .strict() and xpEarned bounded 0..100 (D-06 Tier 1), lessonId tenant-ownership check deferred to follow-up infra track (D-06 Tier 2); (4.5) recordGameCompletion catches unique-violation as duplicate signal, SELECT-before-INSERT remains as fast-path; (4.6) vitest + PGlite live-DB harness mirroring marketing phase-8-projects-live.test.ts pattern, jest for rewritten rankingRoute.test.ts, tenant-coverage gate must stay green; (4.7) seven explicit non-goals (no additional game migration, no host wiring, no xpLogs schoolId, no gameRankings drop, no lessonId ownership check, no lessons schoolId, no activity_type pgEnum extension). Test strategy section 0.D to be updated with six test groups 4A..4F and anti-pattern defenses. Plan.md Phase 4 strategy task marked [x]. Tier 2 items deferred to Phase 5+ / follow-up infra track.
nonblocking_findings: Phase 4 does not add schoolId to xpLogs; dual-write delivers tenant-safety at the gameCompletions layer instead (xpLogs read path unchanged).
Phase 4 does not drop gameRankings; it is deprecated (no new writes) and a future cleanup track may drop it.
Phase 4 does not add the lessonId tenant-ownership check (D-06 Tier 2); requires assignments-based ownership query, deferred to follow-up infra track.
Phase 4 does not migrate additional games beyond haunted-library (Phase 3 scope); remaining 25 games migrate in Phase 5+.
Phase 4 does not wire the host-app import (Phase 5); it delivers the domain query and shared schema only.

leaderboards.schoolId notNull migration operational choice (backfill-and-notNull vs delete-null-rows) is [b] deferred:infra for the deploy engineer; the Tier 1 contract (notNull after migration + FLAT insert rejected without schoolId) is testable regardless.
